text_blocks.snippet: The final deadline to link your PAN with your Aadhaar for individuals who obtained a PAN using an Aadhaar enrolment ID was December 31, 2025, with unlinked PANs becoming inoperative starting January 1, 2026. General linking requirements from earlier deadlines (like June 30, 2023) also remain in effect.
You can check your status or complete delayed linking through the Income Tax e-Filing Portal.

text_blocks.snippet: How to Reactivate an Inoperative PAN

list.snippet: Visit the Income Tax e-Filing Portal.
Pay a late penalty fee of ₹1,000 via e-Pay Tax (under minor head for linking delay).
Submit your PAN and Aadhaar details for validation using OTP authentication.
The PAN typically becomes operative again within 7 to 30 days after processing.
